$comment: Optional, opt-in permission template for the diagnose-cluster skill's kubectl access. There is no hook or other mechanism that applies this automatically — merge the 'permissions' block below into your own .claude/settings.json (project-scoped, shared with your team) or ~/.claude/settings.json (personal) to have Claude Code's permission system enforce this allow/deny list. If you don't merge it, there is no enforcement at this layer. See KUBECTL_GUARDRAILS.md in this directory for what this covers, its limitations, and the read-only kubeconfig that's the real safety boundary — minted per-session with genuine RBAC enforcement; this template is an additional, optional layer on top of that, not a substitute for it.
